corrections.claim: SERIOUS. The record over-counts what a reader can see on the state the row cares most about: 13_messenger_states.report.json says states_on_the_glass {read 1, sent 2, 'it would not go' 1} but the read row is a 125-device-pixel blank sliver with its ink above the frame's top edge and there is no 'read' word or double tick anywhere in the frame; the same clipping costs 02_chat.png one of its four. Their verdict states the read marker is 'recorded and not drawn'.
corrections.what_i_measured: The observation reproduces exactly. 13_messenger_states.png carries 'sent' with one tick twice, 'it would not go' with a red cross once, and no read mark anywhere in its 3,120 rows; the row the report names read (0001M4GW48FEW3M67XKAZT5051) is on the glass as paper from y285 to y415 with no ink in it. 02_chat.png carries three legible 'read' marks with double ticks at 16:40, 17:14 and 19:34 and the fourth row as a ragged edge at the top. But 'recorded and not drawn' is wrong and the attribution overstates: the read marker is drawn, three times, in a legible double tick, in this same build and this same capture. What produced the absence is the framing. scenes/13_messenger_states.json scrolls to 'end', sets the far side's read marker, and only then appends five more rows (a refusal, a staged batch, a slowSend, a second read, typing) — so by the time the shot is taken the read row has been pushed off the top; 02_chat's own report already discloses the same, 'the best of 66 framings of 48 stretches, 8 sheets on the glass and 7 of them whole'. What survives is smaller than the finding as written: states_on_the_glass counts projection rows inside the scroll range rather than ink a reader can see, which is a reporting defect, not a delivery-state defect, and it does not support a serious finding on the row that decides whether the couple leaves Instagram.

Findings nobody took, in descending order of how much they matter: (1) 05_settings.png draws 'android-capture · holds the log' on the glass under the heading THE TWO PHONES with the link reading 'connected · http://127.0.0.1:8480' — the one screen that shows pairing state names an Android device as the holder of the log, on a capture whose MANIFEST says plainly that no Android device was up and that nothing was faked from the PWA; the name is the hard-coded deviceId of the headless host daemon at app/tool/host_daemon.dart:104, 108 and 124, and it also appears in 15_authored_feeling.report.json's devices list beside paired: true. (2) The CG placeholder photographs in 04_moments.png and 14_media_viewer.png were seen by material-truth and by anti-goal and pushed by both to 'whoever scores fidelity', a row that does not exist in this rubric — material-truth logged it as a minor anyway, anti-goal set it aside entirely, so the one place in a build about photographed material where a real photograph would sit is scored by nobody. Coherence saw this and wrote it into its judgements map instead of its findings, so it does not count against the emotional-transmission clause about authored feelings that it bears on. (4) The peer path named in both tailnet records is 192.0.2.2:52340, a TEST-NET-1 documentation address. (5) evidence/logs/webpush.txt is the one file in evidence/logs/ with no line in MANIFEST.json's checks block; all six critics opened it and none noticed. gaps: The provenance record does not reach the evidence that carries the messenger row's hardest claims. MANIFEST.json's checks block covers 55 of the 56 files in evidence/logs/ and nothing else. reliability.json, coldstart.json, frames.json, DIFF.json, WHY_MISSING.json, all fourteen crops and all sixteen scene recipes have no from_this_run line anywhere. Measured against the capture's own start of 2026-09-09T03:52:44Z, WHY_MISSING.json predates it by fourteen hours and every one of the sixteen scene recipes predates it, from 5 September to 02:19 on the 9th. Inside coldstart.json the whole tailnet crossing is written_at 2026-09-05T00:28:41 with a later_check of 'pending' timed at 04:59 on capture morning, and reliability.json's tailscale block carries the same 5 September date under a file generated at 04:59:48. So the strongest correction available in this cycle is one MANIFEST cannot make: the manifest answers from_this_run truthfully for everything it lists, and the four-day-old measurement sits in the two files it does not list. Only messenger-reliability noticed the age, and at minor.

Six critics, five rubric rows, and one row with two scores. Row 04 (coherence and extensibility, weight 15, floor 13) is scored by the coherence critic from the artifacts at 14 and by the code critic from the source at 13, with no rule anywhere for combining them. The review as delivered contains two different answers to the same row and no way to reconcile them.

Nothing in the review is blocking. Forty-three findings: thirteen serious, thirty minor, zero blocking. BRIEFING.md defines blocking as the severity that caps a category at its floor, so by the review's own vocabulary nothing in this cycle asserts that any category is capped — yet two rows come in exactly one point under floor (messenger-reliability 25 of 30 against 26, material truth 21 of 25 against 22). Both below-floor verdicts rest on unweighted judgement rather than on any stated cap, and in the messenger case the serious finding I found overstated is one of the three carrying it.

Three rows that findings were deferred to do not exist. Critics sent measurements to 'the motion row' (scroll_webkit.json, the fling log, the per-clip frames files), to 'the font critic's floor' (hand.json, and by extension fonts.json, hairline.json, tears.json) and to 'whoever scores fidelity' (the CG placeholder media). The rubric is five rows — messenger reliability, material truth, emotional transmission, coherence and extensibility, anti-goal compliance — and none of them owns typography, frame cost or media fidelity. logs/surfaces.json (68 KB of surface colour and contrast) was opened by four critics and produced no finding for the same reason.

Nothing in the evidence was produced on either of the two phones the mission names. Every artifact is WebKit at 1080x2340 or 1440x3120; reception is Chromium on a Linux virtual display and says so; pwa.json is the served page read under WebKit with display_mode_standalone false. There is no installed PWA, no home-screen icon in place, no lock screen, no iOS rendering of anything, and no second screen — so the non-haptic substitute the emotional-transmission row requires, the Android half of the coherence row, and the two-device half of delivery and read state are all unphotographed. Five reports treat the Android absence as a reason rather than an excuse and I agree; the Apple absence is barely named, and it is the half the brief calls installable.

Nothing shows the app while it is loading. 01_pulse's fresh-store load is 8,240 ms and dusk_pulse's is 7,813 ms against warm loads of 2,016 to 2,316 ms, and no artifact covers those seconds, so the row's clause about a spinner that outstays its welcome cannot be decided either way from this set. Messenger-reliability names this at minor and it is the only place it appears.

Two of the five delivery states the code declares — queued ('waiting to send') and sending ('going') — appear in no artifact and in no report field in the whole capture, which are precisely the two a person sees when the link is down. Named once, at minor.

No critic checked a single artifact against the recipe that produced it, and three declared the recipes not worth opening. That is the check that separates a fault in the build from a fault in the framing, and its absence is what let the read-marker finding be filed as a build defect at serious severity when scenes/13_messenger_states.json shows the read row being marked and then pushed off the top of the viewport by five later steps. Where the recipe was read — emotional-transmission opened five of them and used the far-side lines to time arrivals to the frame — it is the strongest evidence in the cycle.

The evidence carries no measurement of anything at rest over time. Every clip is driven at 16 ms a step, every still is a settle-and-shoot, and reliability.json runs in one process tree; nothing in the set shows the app after an hour, after a day, or after the far side has been gone long enough for the outbox to matter, and no row asks for it.
verdict: The review is thorough and, where it can be checked, honest: I reproduced twenty-four load-bearing claims and twenty-one came out as written or tighter. The two headline numbers hold — the scroll measures 0.219 device pixels of mean error against the fling log across all 299 pairs where the report claims 0.34, and scroll_webkit's 793 of 793 over budget reproduces to the digit, median 123, p90 803, p99 1613. The held-frame floor that nobody re-ran holds with margin: zero held frames in 1,820 pairs, with the share term alone disqualifying all but one. The material findings hold on measurement and, more convincingly, in the pictures — the hold object is a countable-facet untextured render under a shadow flat to within ten levels across 120 pixels, the goodnight object's ring is within six points of equal on four sides where the ink-on-paper feelings beside it run 3.5 against 17.3, and the desk carries about a thirtieth of the paper's fine detail over 46 per cent of one frame and 78 per cent of another. Four claims are off. Emotional transmission counts twenty reliability rows where there are nineteen and says 'feeling' appears once when it appears twice, in a row that does exercise a feeling path; messenger reliability explains two blank gallery tiles with an arithmetic its own cited record refutes (blobs waiting: 0); coherence's judgement for 13_messenger_states asserts four delivery states on a screen that carries three. The one that changes a score is the read marker: the observation is exactly right — no read mark anywhere in 13_messenger_states.png, three legible ones in 02_chat.png against a record claiming four — but 'recorded and not drawn' is wrong, because the scene marks the row read and then appends five more rows that push it off the top, and 02_chat's own report already discloses seven whole sheets of eight. What remains is that states_on_the_glass counts projection rows rather than visible ink, which is a reporting defect, not the delivery-state failure that a serious finding on the row deciding whether the couple leaves Instagram requires. Coverage is good and its shape is telling: no delivered artifact went unopened, but eleven of sixteen scene recipes did, and nobody checked one artifact against the recipe that made it — the exact check that would have caught the framing above. The largest thing nobody took is on a screen all five artifact critics opened and none wrote about: 05_settings.png draws 'android-capture · holds the log' under THE TWO PHONES with the link reading 127.0.0.1, in a capture whose manifest says no Android device existed, while a sibling report's serious finding says there is no picture of the Android build anywhere. And the correction the manifest was extended to make, it cannot make: every check it lists is genuinely from this run, and the four-day-old tailnet crossing — its peer path a TEST-NET-1 documentation address — sits in reliability.json and coldstart.json, two files the manifest does not list at all.
